body_text:
An explicit definition introduces notation by stipulating a
meaning in terms of previously understood concepts. A good
definition is conservative: it creates an abbreviation or a new
interface, not an additional theorem about existing objects. An
implicit definition instead characterizes an object by
properties; it is legitimate only after existence and
sufficient uniqueness have been established or adopted as
axioms.
